description:
Snapdragons (Antirrhinum majus) are colorful, non-toxic flowers that are a safe and popular choice for gardens and bouquets where cats might be present. Their unique, dragon-shaped blossoms add a playful touch to any setting, and they pose no known risk if a curious cat decides to nibble on them.

These flowers do not contain any compounds that are considered harmful to cats. While it is always best to discourage pets from eating large amounts of any plant material, as it can cause mild stomach upset, snapdragons are one of the safer options for a pet-friendly home and garden.

Enjoy the vibrant colors and whimsical shape of snapdragons without worrying about your cat's safety. They provide a cheerful and worry-free way to bring the beauty of nature indoors or to liven up your outdoor space.
name: Snapdragon
